    // The tightest axis-aligned rectangle containing every listed point.
    // Precondition: at least one point.
    BoundsOfPoints(points: Array<Point2D>): Bounds2D
    {
        var lo = points.Reduce(points.First, (acc, p) => Point2D(acc.X.Min(p.X), acc.Y.Min(p.Y)));
        var hi = points.Reduce(points.First, (acc, p) => Point2D(acc.X.Max(p.X), acc.Y.Max(p.Y)));
        return (lo, hi);
    }
```

    // The tightest axis-aligned box containing every listed point.
    // Precondition: at least one point.
    BoundsOfPoints(points: Array<Point3D>): Bounds3D
    {
        var lo = points.Reduce(points.First, (acc, p) => Point3D(acc.X.Min(p.X), acc.Y.Min(p.Y), acc.Z.Min(p.Z)));
        var hi = points.Reduce(points.First, (acc, p) => Point3D(acc.X.Max(p.X), acc.Y.Max(p.Y), acc.Z.Max(p.Z)));
        return (lo, hi);
    }
```
